fixtureDelta.listenerOrder: the swallower is a capture-phase keydown listener on document registered BEFORE both recorders (same target, same phase, so registration order decides who reads the flag)

swallowGate.api: window.__setSwallow(on, keys) — idempotent, clears then sets

fixtureDelta.urlToggle: none: the fixture JS reads no location/query/hash/cookie/window.name and references no external URL

capslockTrace.derivation: the [a-f] chars of the nonce hex tail in order, cycled to 4

shiftDetector.mechanism: getModifierState('Shift') on the page's own keydown/keyup record

chordLeg.derivation: first [a-f] char of the nonce hex tail

swallowLeg.derivation: the nonce hex tail: its first two characters for the control, its third for the swallowed insertion

capsLockLeg.derivation: the [a-f] chars of the nonce hex tail in order, cycled to 4
